DFNS provides an MPC self-custody solution
company.description:
This is a big, and I mean BIG deal. Let me explain why. 

DFNS provides an MPC self-custody solution, which is used primarily as an API product by fintech, custody and other companies that need to automate digital asset transactions. 

Up until now, they could only move money programmatically unencrypted. This means anyone onchain could see everything. This is very bad if you are building a neobank or if you are a market maker trading on open markets. 

By integrating @zama and the ERC-7984 confidential token standard, @dfnsHQ is now enabling all those customers to move money, trade and settle onchain *confidentially*, just as easily as they did before with non-confidential ERC-20 tokens. 

I am very very excited about the design space this creates, and the opportunities it unlocks. 

I'll do a much deeper post about it next week!
